exposure: Women with a previous Cesarean section
outcome: Overall rate of Cesarean section (CS) after induction of labor (IOL)
CS for failure to progress in the active phase of labor or failed IOL
cohort: 265 pregnant women undergoing IOL at term
finding: Lower uterine segment (LUS) thickness measured before induction of labor was found to be a significant and independent predictor of overall CS and CS for failure to progress in labor or failed IOL.
